title: Working on some new levels (Valiant Steel)
author: HeadOpen4823
selftext: I'm having way too much fun with this project

comments.author: thewowcollector
comments.body: Gives some great PSONE vibes - how did you make it?

replies.author: HeadOpen4823
replies.body: Everything was made with Chatgpt Astra, Unity, and Blender. Got the pro suscription and just started prompting. Everything including the models and textures where all done by the AI. It can even be played in online co-op. And I dont know a single thing about programming.

replies.author: Pied_Film10
replies.body: This game always looks good. This and the other cutesy game the other Redditor is making

comments.author: deReaLizedGames
comments.body: I'm beyond impressed, you're doing an amazing job! You should be really proud of yourself.

comments.author: Caffeine_Blitzkrieg
comments.body: Looks sick! How did you make the music and voice lines? Always seems to be a weak point for me, the AI defaults to weak midi tunes.

replies.author: HeadOpen4823
replies.body: I used Suno and Elevenlabs. Yeah i had to create a lot of different music until I got some that were decent
